interactions.note: The epitope of nanobody NbGpsD-7 on the N-terminal periplasmic domain of enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli GspD was determined by diffraction of the complex of antibody with Se-Met-labeled peri-GspD. The GspD The asymmetric unit contains four molecules of the nanobodies and four molecules of the protein. Two nanobodies together with two peri-GspD chains form a complex heterotetramer -- an unseen before arrangement. Each Nb7 chain in the heterotetramer interacts with the N0 and N1 subdomains of peri-GspD and the second Nb7 molecule in the GspD:Nb7 heterotetramer, via an anti-parallel arrangement of β-strands.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.8 angstroms
